notes: Solar flares: only M-class and above kept. severity = NOAA radio blackout scale R1-R5 (M1=R1, M5=R2, X1=R3, X10=R4, X20=R5).
Geomagnetic storms: severity = NOAA G-scale from max Kp (Kp5=G1 ... Kp9=G5). Kp is measured at Earth, so apply these only near Earth (launch, sample capsule return).
CMEs: only speed >= 1000 km/s kept. severity is game-defined: 1000-1499 km/s = 3, 1500-1999 = 4, 2000+ = 5.
Game effects (failure chance etc.) are game-defined and should be listed in README.
